responsibility: Declares the tree-level exception-handling interfaces used across GCC’s GIMPLE middle end. It exposes APIs for EH landing-pad lookup and mutation, EH-edge construction and redirection, trap/throw predicates on trees and statements, cleanup and duplication helpers for EH annotations during transformations, unreachable-handler cleanup, and verification utilities for EH CFG edges.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the public declaration surface for tree-level EH support. Unlike gcc/tree-eh.cc, it does not implement EH bookkeeping or cleanup; it exposes the cross-module function prototypes and types used by other GIMPLE passes.
